mechanism.claim: Immediately after a scheduled BTC perpetual funding settlement in a volatile regime, continuation versus crowding reversal depends on the level, change and acceleration of the last three funding rates jointly with the completed premium path; one fixed pre-2023 classifier estimates the next-eight-hour sign.
mechanism.why_distinct: HVFPSC uses a continuous scheduled funding/premium state model, not an extreme-funding event, funding residual rank, settlement ignition/cooling rule, OI rule, ordinal dynamics, or any prior event/control outcome.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: scheduled post-funding 8h state classification is absent from Gross9

training_contract.decisions: exact funding_time rows on 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC; funding at D is available at D and entry is D+5m
training_contract.label: strict sign log(exit_open/entry_open), exit=entry+8h strictly before label end; zero rejected
training_contract.estimator: closed-form standardized ridge classifier targets {-1,+1}, intercept, alpha100
training_contract.score_threshold: numpy linear q60 absolute fitted score among high-vol training rows; OOS uses >=

feature_contract.funding: exact unique funding_rates_binance BTCUSDT rows at D-16h,D-8h,D; rates finite; current row included only because entry is D+5m
feature_contract.normalized_returns: full/final2h returns divided by sqrt(sum 479 squared close returns)
feature_contract.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank <=270 valid blocks minimum180 current excluded
feature_contract.funding_features: current f0, change f0-f1, acceleration f0-2f1+f2, sum f0+f1+f2
feature_contract.premium_features: full mean, final2h mean, terminal, terminal-first
feature_contract.interactions: normalized full return times current funding and premium change

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, variation_rank>=0.65, frozen score finite/nonzero, abs score>=q60
oos_clock.funding_accounting: signal may use current completed rate; PnL includes exact settlements entry<=time<exit only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity exact funding 6bp/10bp sides strict held 5m MDD full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: new continuous scheduled funding-state classifier before labels/incidence

stopping_rule: freeze sequentially; terminal first failure; no feature/alpha/threshold/side/hold/clock/subset/control repair
